# FocusPort

> FocusPort is a free Android app that blocks distracting apps during focus sessions using Android Accessibility Service. It is designed to reduce doomscrolling and compulsive app switching without easy bypasses.

## Overview
- [FocusPort website](https://focusport.in)
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.focusport.app)
- [Privacy policy](https://focusport.github.io/focusport-privacy/)
- [Blog](https://focusport.in/blog/)

## Key Features
- Blocks selected apps during timed focus sessions
- Prevents easy bypasses by breaking the streak when a session is exited early
- Includes an emergency app whitelist for essential apps
- Supports scheduled automatic sessions
- Tracks streaks and session history
- Works offline
- Uses Accessibility Service for real blocking
